dedupe_keys.name: uk national river flow archive nrfa daily and peak river flows

description: The UK National River Flow Archive (NRFA), hosted by the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology, is the country's main archive of daily and peak river flows. It holds daily, monthly and flood peak data from over 1,500 gauging stations run by the Environment Agency, Natural Resources Wales, SEPA and Northern Ireland's Rivers agency, plus station metadata and catchment information on land use, geology and climate, catchment rainfall, and naturalised flows where available. Time series download from a map-based search as CSV files with a station header, value and quality flag, or through a JSON API (station-ids, station-info and time-series services) that is still labelled a test service. The Peak Flow Dataset, version 15 released on 27 August 2026 with data to September 2025, packages annual maxima, peaks over threshold and catchment descriptors for the WINFAP flood frequency software. Use is free and royalty-free, commercial or not, under a click-through licence that requires the acknowledgement "Data from the UK National River Flow Archive" and bars re-hosting the data for download. Caveats: not every data type exists for every station, data change through rolling updates without notice, and API caching is limited to 30 days. Simulation uses: flood frequency estimation for dams, defences and drainage, drought and low-flow analysis for water supply, calibration of catchment and flood models, and hydropower yield. Related records: the Environment Agency real-time flood monitoring API (data-uk-ea-real-time-flood-monitoring-api).
